errors.text_span: within a dataset of 1.4 million data entries
errors.evidence: The description states the total number of entries is 1.4 million. This value is not directly displayed on the chart but is a calculation derived from summing the absolute numbers in the legend (which total 1,399,991). This goes beyond describing the visual information.
The description shortens the category name 'Information Seeking' to 'Information'. The full name is clearly visible in the legend and on the chart itself.
The description incorrectly claims that a legend is not present, when there is a clearly visible legend in the top-left corner of the chart listing all categories and their absolute counts.

errors.text_span: Information seeks 22.2% of the data entries
errors.evidence: The phrasing 'Information seeks 22.2%' is grammatically awkward. A better phrasing would be 'Information Seeking accounts for 22.2%'.
